questions.stem: An architect's brief: if F'=f, then ∫_a^b f(x) dx equals F(b)-F(a); with F(b)=10, F(a)=3, value?
questions.explanation: F(b)-F(a)=10-3=7. The tempting wrong idea adds to get 13.
